dynamic_line:
It has happened so many times.  A new recruit thinks they can beat fire with fire and goes past the point of no return.  When it happens, they either become another vampire or a killer of hunters.

For everyone's sake, I won't let you go down that path no matter what I must do.

responses.text: It won't happen to me, though.
I won't take the cure.  There's nothing you can do about it.

dynamic_line: They all said that, but it happened to each of them.  I won't ask again.  If you refuse the cure, we will have no choice but to kill you.

responses.text: I won't take the cure.  There's nothing you can do about it.
